analysisSummary: Primary friction sits on the nested click action: unclear location and moderate pain. Persona goals emphasize completing setup without support.

requirements.title: Clarify where to click on Home
requirements.problemStatement: Users hesitate on the home screen because the target control for onboarding is not obvious.
requirements.businessContext: Onboarding demo — reduce drop-off on first session.
requirements.whyImportant: Supports persona goal to finish setup without support tickets.

hypothesis.if: Users see an explicit primary CTA on Home
hypothesis.then: They proceed to the nested click step with confidence

researchEvidence: Journey map — pain on nested action
requirements.inScope: Copy, layout, and focus state for the primary control
requirements.successCriteria: Users complete the click step without backtracking
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Primary action visible without scroll; accessible name matches user mental model

userStory.title: Clear primary CTA on Home
userStory.iWant: see where to click to continue onboarding
userStory.soThat: I can finish setup without asking for help
userStory.dependencies: Design tokens, analytics event for CTA click
userStory.acceptanceCriteria: Given I land on Home, when I scan the page, then one primary CTA is obvious within 3 seconds
